title: Design System: Ascentware Social Media Platform

headline-md.purpose: The single page-level <h1> per surface (Organizations, Dashboard, Add Platform).

title.purpose: Extension: 18px, weight raised to 600 for slide-over panel headings.

subtitle.purpose: Extension: 16px, weight raised to 700 for compact centered-dialog headings.

body-md.purpose: The one-sentence description under a page's <h1>.

label-md.purpose: The workhorse size: button text, org/platform/account row titles, nav links.

label-sm.purpose: 12px; tracked+uppercase for section labels, untracked for metadata prose (Caption).

micro.purpose: Extension: 10px, below the source ramp's floor — the Current chip only.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Right-edge slide-over panels (OrgDetailSheet, AccountPicker); mirrored for the left-edge mobile nav drawer.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: Scrim entrance behind any slide-over panel.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid white fill, bold blue text — the source spec's literal primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #004d65; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6dd2ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White 40%-opacity ghost border, on-surface text — the default action button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #cce6f4; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6dd2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Error-toned outline, reserved for destructive confirmation (Delete organization).
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #ffb4ab; border: 1px solid rgba(255,180,171,0.5); font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover, .ds-btn-danger:active { background: rgba(147,0,10,0.4); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6dd2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed surface-container-high background, outline-variant border, turns white on focus per the source spec.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #3e484e; background: #142d37; color: #cce6f4; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(189,200,207,0.7); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Colored text on a matching low-opacity container tint, per connection state (success/pending/error/neutral).
components.html: Connected
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #7fe0a6; background: #123d2b; }

components.name: Org Card
components.description: The primary content row: a translucent-white card with a status dot, name/meta, and platform badges. Replaces the prior world's paper strip.
components.css: .ds-org-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; text-align: left; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding: 14px 16px; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-org-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-org-card-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #7fe0a6; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-org-card-name { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #cce6f4; } .ds-org-card-meta { display: block; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #bdc8cf; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: 224px fixed column (sm and up), icon + label links, active link on a primary/15 tint with primary text/icon.
components.html: DashboardOrganizationsAdd Platform
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 224px; padding-top: 20px; background: #001018; border-right: 1px solid #3e484e; height: 100%; } .ds-sidebar-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 0 12px; } .ds-sidebar-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #bdc8cf; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-sidebar-link:hover { color: #cce6f4; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-sidebar-link-active { background: rgba(109,210,255,0.15); color: #6dd2ff; }

components.name: Top Header
components.description: 56px bar paired with the sidebar. Left: mobile hamburger + brand lockup. Right: settings icon and account avatar — intentional placeholders, no destination yet.
components.html: AAscentware
components.css: .ds-topheader { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: #001018; border-bottom: 1px solid #3e484e; } .ds-topheader-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #cce6f4; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brandmark { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 6px; background: #6dd2ff; color: #003547; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; } .ds-topheader-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-topheader-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #bdc8cf; border: none; } .ds-topheader-avatar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1f3843; color: #bdc8cf; border: none; }

components.name: Slide-Over Panel
components.description: Right-edge panel (org detail, account picker) that slides over the page, surface-container-high with an outline border and shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; width: 100%; max-width: 32rem; background: #142d37; border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); box-shadow: -16px 0 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transform: translateX(0); transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-panel-header { padding: 20px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #cce6f4; }

components.name: Catalog Table
components.description: Shared table pattern for admin-catalog lists (OrganizationsTable, PlatformsTable): rounded-lg outline container, uppercase Label-SM header row, hairline row separators, brighten-on-hover, EmptyState row when empty.
components.html:
PlatformSummaryAccounts calledActions
TikTokShort-form videoAccount / AccountsEdit
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-table thead tr { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-table th { padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #bdc8cf; } .ds-table-actions-head { text-align: right; } .ds-table td { padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size: 14px; color: #cce6f4; } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-table-muted { color: #bdc8cf; font-size: 12px; } .ds-table-actions { text-align: right; }

components.name: Credential Field Row
components.description: Nested card row for an admin-defined, arbitrary-length list of key/value pairs (Add Platform credential builder): Field Name input, Value input (password when secret), Secret checkbox, Remove icon-button.
components.css: .ds-field-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding: 10px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-field-row-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-field-row-input label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #bdc8cf; } .ds-field-row-input input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #3e484e; background: #142d37; color: #cce6f4; font-size: 14px; } .ds-field-row-input input:focus-visible { border-color: #ffffff; outline: 2px solid #6dd2ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-row-secret { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding-bottom: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #bdc8cf; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-field-row-remove { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #bdc8cf; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-field-row-remove:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #cce6f4; }

narrative.overview:
A high-contrast dark mode anchored on a vibrant, architectural blue. The brand personality is precise, technical, and high-energy — built for professionals who need a focused environment that feels both cutting-edge and structurally sound. The aesthetic blends minimalism with a technological glow: a near-black navy base (#00161f) holds the interface, and a saturated cyan-blue (primary #6dd2ff, primary-container #2bb3e4) carries every point of emphasis — CTAs, active states, focus rings, the current selection. The emotional register is clarity and digital sophistication: intense saturation used sparingly to mark what matters, extreme legibility everywhere else.

This system resolves one tension in the source brief: its prose describes primary blue as the foundational background, while its own token export defines background/surface as near-black and reserves primary as an accent role (the standard Material-3 pattern this token set is built on). The token export is treated as normative here — dark navy is the base, vibrant blue is the accent — since an all-blue background would fight the same brief's own legibility goal and isn't how its component specs (white-on-navy buttons, navy recessed inputs, frosted-white cards) actually read.

This is a full replacement of a prior kraft-paper/graphite/grease-pencil world, not an extension of it — cards and list rows replace that world's paper strips outright.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy base with a saturated cyan-blue accent — dark mode, not an inverted light theme
Manrope throughout, weights pushed toward semi-bold/bold for headings against dark surfaces
"Frosted Azure" elevation: translucent white fills and 1px white-opacity outlines stand in for shadows
Cards and list rows — a full replacement of the prior strip-based world
One persistent app shell (sidebar + header) carries navigation

rules.name: The Accent, Not Ambient, Rule
rules.body: Primary blue marks emphasis — buttons, focus, the current selection — never a full-page or full-panel background. Large surfaces stay on the neutral surface ladder; saturation is spent where it means something.

rules.name: The Outline Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from translucent white fills and 1px white-opacity borders ("Frosted Azure"), not colored drop shadows. Reserve the one shadow token for slide-over panels only.

rules.name: The Weight-Over-Size Rule
rules.body: Where a heading needs to sit at a size the ramp already uses for body copy (Title at 18px, Subtitle at 16px), raise the weight instead of inventing a new size.

rules.name: The Field-Not-List Rule
rules.body: When a form needs an admin-defined, open-ended set of values (Add Platform's credential fields) rather than a fixed schema, build it as appendable Credential Field Rows on the existing Input/Checkbox/IconButton vocabulary — never pre-populate from a hardcoded list.

dos: Do use Manrope at the documented weight for every size step; don't introduce a second face.
Do spend primary blue on emphasis only — buttons, focus, the current-item state — never as a passive background fill.
Do use outlines and tonal surface steps for depth; reserve the one shadow token for slide-over panels only.
Do raise weight rather than size when a heading needs to share a body size step.
Do keep numeric list data in .tabular.
donts: Don't fill a large surface with saturated primary blue — accent, don't flood.
Don't add a colored or soft drop shadow to a card, row, or badge.
Don't revive the prior kraft-paper/graphite/grease-pencil world's motifs (die-cut clips, hand-inked wobble) — this is a full replacement.
Don't add a footer, a second sidebar, or per-surface navigation. AppShell is the one persistent chrome.
Don't introduce a fifth status color; reuse success/pending/error/neutral-surface.
